spans.s:
mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
Squint-eyed.
m. (-रः)
The name of a plant.
E.
क the earth or the head, दृ to divide, affix अच्.

m. (-रः)
1 A field, a meadow, a plain.
2 A mountain.
3 A name of Ś

A particular place, the modern Kedār, part of the Himālaya mountains.
5 A basin for water round the root of a tree.
6 A bed in a garden or field.
E.
क water, earth, &c. दृ to tear or rend, घञ् aff.

n. (-ण्डं)
A small dyke or mound, earth raised to keep out water.
E.
केदार, and खण्ड a portion.
